text: STANDALONE LINKS AND FOOTER LINKS ARE 24px TARGETS. A standalone link — a card's "Read more", a row in a list of reports — and the footer's policy links drew a 17-20px text box, under the WCAG 2.2 minimum. Each now carries the minimum height itself and centres its own text. An inline link inside a sentence is untouched: there the line is the target, and the criterion's inline exception covers it.
